===Levels 70-99:  Nightmare Zone===
Since [[Dharok the Wretched's equipment|Dharok's]] [[Dharok the Wretched's equipment#Set effect|potential]] is dependent on having high max {{SCP|Hitpoints||link=yes}}, it becomes optimal at {{SCP|Hitpoints|92+|link=yes}}. Otherwise, the full Blood Moon Armour + Dual Macuahuitl, or the combination of [[Obsidian armour|Obsidian Armour]], a [[Berserker necklace|Berserker Necklace]], and the [[Toktz-xil-ak|Toktz-Xil-Ak]] is optimal. {{Melee training monster
|name = [[Nightmare Zone]]
|combat = Varies
|hitpoints = Varies
|requirements = At least 5 quests that Nightmare Zone requires
|recommendations = Refer to the [[Nightmare Zone]] page for more information
|advantages =
*Fastest solo experience per hour for Attack and Strength
*Alternatively, offers the most AFK training method in the game (using normal customisable rumble setup with absorption potions)
*Use of overload and absorption potions, gained from NMZ points which reduces the need for super combat and prayer potions
*Points can be used for imbues that upgrade equipment, or to purchase [[herb boxes]] for some profit
*No competition from other players; Nightmare Zone is instanced and deaths are safe (Unless playing as a Hardcore Group Ironman)
*This is a safe minigame and you will not lose any items upon death/leaving apart from dropped items in the arena
*Possible to earn decent Defence experience with a Venator Bow using the long-range attack style.
|disadvantages=
*Requires a coin fee to start, and some quests to utilise
*Players may need super combat and prayer potions for the first few games as they have no points
*No drops other than spending points
|locations = North of [[Yanille]], north-west of the bank
}}
